topic: 基础综合复测与薄弱项整理 · Independent new scenario: a group revising a plan after new evidence
grammarFocus: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.

title: The Community Garden Plan: Revising After New Evidence
instructions: 这是为B1水平学习者设计的原创模拟听力与语法练习（非官方雅思材料，场景与数据均为虚构）。请先听/读对话，注意说话人如何根据新证据修改计划。然后完成8道听力理解题（单选、填空、匹配、判断）。接着学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案必须来自材料原文。
transcript:
Mia: Okay, everyone. Thanks for coming to the community garden meeting. We need to revise our plan for the spring planting day.
Ben: Why? What happened?
Mia: The city sent an email this morning. They will close the water tap in the garden next week for repairs.
Carla: Oh no. So we can't use the water tap on planting day?
Mia: Right. The tap will be off from Monday to Friday. Our planting day is next Saturday, so the tap will be back on. But we need a backup plan.
Ben: Wait, is planting day on Saturday? I thought it was on Sunday.
Mia: No, it's Saturday. I checked the calendar twice. Sunday is the rain date.
Carla: Okay. So what do we do about water?
Mia: We can ask the school next door. They have two big water tanks. I called them, and they said yes.
Ben: Great. How many tanks do they have?
Mia: Two. Each tank holds fifty liters. That's enough for our twenty small trees.
Carla: Do we still need volunteers to bring bottles?
Mia: Yes, but only ten bottles, not thirty. The tanks will do most of the work.
Ben: And what about the tools? Last time we had only five spades for twelve people.
Mia: Good point. The hardware store will lend us ten spades. I asked them yesterday.
Carla: Nice. So the new plan is: meet at nine, get water from the school, and start planting at ten?
Mia: Almost. Meet at eight thirty, because we need time to move the tanks.
Ben: Eight thirty is early, but okay. Who will bring the snacks?
Mia: I will. And Carla, can you send the new plan to everyone tonight?
Carla: Sure. I'll send it after dinner.

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量与常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 英语中，一般现在时表示习惯或事实（如 The tap is off.），一般将来时表示计划或预测（如 They will close the tap.）。问句常把助动词或 be 动词提前（如 Do we need bottles? / Is planting day on Saturday?）。名词数量要注意可数名词的复数（two tanks, ten bottles）和不可数名词（water）。常见从句如 because 引导原因（because we need time），that 引导宾语从句（I thought it was on Sunday）。
grammar.example: The city sent an email this morning. They will close the water tap in the garden next week for repairs.

options: She will send the plan tonight.
She will sends the plan tonight.
answers: She will send the plan tonight.
questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形，所以用 send。
questions.evidence: Carla: Sure. I'll send it after dinner.

questions.explanation: 一般现在时主语是 we，助动词用 do，放在句首构成问句。
questions.evidence: Do we still need volunteers to bring bottles?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct noun form: There are two ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation: two 后接可数名词复数，tank 的复数是 tanks。
questions.evidence: They have two big water tanks.

options: We meet at eight thirty because we need time to move the tanks.
We meet at eight thirty because we needing time to move the tanks.
We meet at eight thirty because we need time move the tanks.
answers: We meet at eight thirty because we need time to move the tanks.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句，从句用完整的主谓结构 we need time。
questions.evidence: Meet at eight thirty, because we need time to move the tanks.

options: The tap will not be on next week.
The tap will not on next week.
The tap not will be on next week.
answers: The tap will not be on next week.
questions.explanation: will 的否定是 will not + 动词原形，be 动词不能省略。
questions.evidence: The tap will be off from Monday to Friday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about quantity.
options: How many tanks do they have?
How much tanks do they have?
answers: How many tanks do they have?
questions.explanation: How many 后接可数名词复数，问句需要助动词 do。
questions.evidence: Ben: Great. How many tanks do they have?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with 'that' clause.
options: I thought that planting day was on Sunday.
I thought that planting day is on Sunday.
I thought that planting day were on Sunday.
answers: I thought that planting day was on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主句是过去时 thought，宾语从句表示过去的情况，用 was 保持时态一致。
questions.evidence: Ben: Wait, is planting day on Saturday? I thought it was on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with 'be' question.
options: Is the planting day on Saturday?
Does the planting day on Saturday?
The planting day is on Saturday?
answers: Is the planting day on Saturday?
questions.explanation: 含有 be 动词的句子变问句时，把 be 动词提前。
questions.evidence: Ben: Wait, is planting day on Saturday?
